title: Publish FFTA DE-ReBuild 1.1.0
changes: Publish the 1.1.0 release and correct the release notes to reflect availability and distinct internal version numbering.
validation: GitHub reports v1.1.0 as public and latest, with tag pointing to 6bcf5d27f1ce8a1395b40436f3760c7ee3f61166; all nine uploaded asset sizes and SHA256 digests matched the staged files.
limitations: The release tag is on decomp; the default main branch remains at the earlier release. Windows was validated under Wine; Android is a debug-signed preview and was not tested on a physical device.
